cancellationAndRefundPolicy.title: Cancellation and Refund Policy
cancellationAndRefund.sections.cancellat: The tenant can cancel the reservation before the start of the stay under the following conditions:
The cancellation must be officially communicated to the host through the app.
Cancellation fees may apply according to the policy specified during the booking process.
If the reservation is canceled 7 days prior to the booking date, the full amount will be refunded.
If the reservation is canceled 4 days prior to the booking date, a 50% cancellation fee will be deducted.
If the reservation is canceled 2 days or less before the booking date, no refund will be issued.
The cancellation and refund policy may be clearly specified during the booking process, including the allowable cancellation period and applicable fees.
The host reserves the right to cancel the reservation in exceptional circumstances, such as unavailability of the accommodation or emergencies.
In case of cancellation by the host, a full refund will be issued to the tenant without any cancellation fees.
cancellationAndRefund.sections.communica: For any inquiries regarding the cancellation and refund policy, please directly contact the host through the app.
For disputes or additional inquiries, please contact the customer support team via email at
cancellationAndRefundPolicy.note: Note: The terms and conditions outlined in the cancellation and refund policy apply to all bookings, tenants, and hosts on the app.

spotXPrivacyPolicy.title: SpotX Privacy Policy
spotXPrivacyPolicy.introduction: Thank you for choosing SpotX! Your privacy and trust are important to us, and we are committed to safeguarding your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our reservation app and website.
Personal Information: SpotX collects personal information such as your name, address, email, phone number, and, in some cases, financial information. This information is collected to enforce our policies, provide our services, resolve conflicts, collect fees, troubleshoot issues, encourage safe trade practices, customize user experiences, measure interest in our services, improve our services, and send targeted ads and marketing promotions based on your preferences.
Usage Information: We may automatically collect information from your computer, internet browser, and SpotX cookies, including your IP address and pages visited on the app.
spotXPrivacyPolicy.howWeUseYourInformati: We use the information we collect for various purposes, including:
Providing services and communicating with you about the provision of these services.
Sending you offers from our app or marketing partners.
Responding to legal investigations, court orders, legal processes, or claims of rights violations.
Utilizing information published on the app pages, which is chosen by users and is not the personal information provided during registration.
spotXPrivacyPolicy.informationSharing.in: We may share your information in the following circumstances:
spotXPrivacyPolicy.informationSharing.tr: With trusted partners who assist us in providing services or communicating with you, but they do not have independent rights to own or share this information.
spotXPrivacyPolicy.informationSharing.le: In response to legal investigations, court orders, legal processes, or claims of rights violations.
spotXPrivacyPolicy.informationSharing.so: Using your posted content on social media apps for advertising purposes, either for you or for SpotX.
spotXPrivacyPolicy.yourChoices.heading: Your Choices
spotXPrivacyPolicy.yourChoices.intro: You have the following choices regarding your information:
spotXPrivacyPolicy.yourChoices.optOutPro: Opting out of receiving promotional communications from us.
spotXPrivacyPolicy.yourChoices.updateInf: Accessing and updating your personal information through your SpotX account.
spotXPrivacyPolicy.dataRetention.heading: Data Retention
spotXPrivacyPolicy.dataRetention.policy: We retain your information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy.
spotXPrivacyPolicy.internationalTransfer: By choosing to provide us with personal information, you consent to the transfer of this data to our servers located in the United States.
spotXPrivacyPolicy.policyScope.heading: Policy Scope
spotXPrivacyPolicy.policyScope.appliesTo: This policy applies only to SpotX-owned apps and channels. It does not apply to affiliated apps or channels not owned or controlled by SpotX, nor does it apply to employees or personnel not employed by SpotX.
Users are prohibited from using our app to collect data about other users or send them annoying messages, as this violates our Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.
